label: Analog Input
description: Generic scaled analog process value (level, pressure, temperature, flow, ...) with the full ISA-18.2-aligned HiHi/Hi/Lo/LoLo alarm ladder, each independently enabled with its own setpoint and mandatory deadband.

questionnaire.name: opc_server
questionnaire.description: OPC UA connection name configured in the Gateway.

questionnaire.name: device_path
questionnaire.description: OPC device path root for this analog input instance, e.g. '[default]PLC1/AI/LT101'.

questionnaire.name: eng_unit
questionnaire.description: Engineering unit for the process value, e.g. 'kPa', 'degC', 'm3/h'.

questionnaire.name: eng_low
questionnaire.description: Engineering range low.

questionnaire.name: eng_high
questionnaire.description: Engineering range high.

questionnaire.name: value_deadband
questionnaire.description: Tag-level (scan/update) deadband in engineering units — separate from any alarm deadband.

questionnaire.name: enable_hihi_alarm
questionnaire.description: Enable the HiHi (High priority) alarm.

questionnaire.name: hihi_setpoint
questionnaire.description: HiHi alarm setpoint, in engineering units (used only if enable_hihi_alarm).

questionnaire.name: hihi_deadband
questionnaire.description: HiHi alarm deadband, in engineering units (used only if enable_hihi_alarm).

questionnaire.name: enable_hi_alarm
questionnaire.description: Enable the Hi (Medium priority) alarm.

questionnaire.name: hi_setpoint
questionnaire.description: Hi alarm setpoint, in engineering units (used only if enable_hi_alarm).

questionnaire.name: hi_deadband
questionnaire.description: Hi alarm deadband, in engineering units (used only if enable_hi_alarm).

questionnaire.name: enable_lo_alarm
questionnaire.description: Enable the Lo (Medium priority) alarm.

questionnaire.name: lo_setpoint
questionnaire.description: Lo alarm setpoint, in engineering units (used only if enable_lo_alarm).

questionnaire.name: lo_deadband
questionnaire.description: Lo alarm deadband, in engineering units (used only if enable_lo_alarm).

questionnaire.name: enable_lolo_alarm
questionnaire.description: Enable the LoLo (High priority) alarm.

questionnaire.name: lolo_setpoint
questionnaire.description: LoLo alarm setpoint, in engineering units (used only if enable_lolo_alarm).

questionnaire.name: lolo_deadband
questionnaire.description: LoLo alarm deadband, in engineering units (used only if enable_lolo_alarm).

questionnaire.name: enable_history
questionnaire.description: Enable tag history on the process value. Deliberate opt-in per the history convention.

questionnaire.name: history_deadband
questionnaire.description: Historical deadband, in engineering units (used only if enable_history).
